title: Stand Out of Our Light - pulled forward for AI product dev?
description:
Hello - I’m building getstrata.ai to create context infrastructure for agents. The daylight/starlight/flashlight concepts in Stand Out of Our Light by James Williams have been formative…at this point my copy is dog-eared, bookmarked, and annotated to the point it may be an altogether new work of art.
I’m looking for applications of Williams’ framework in agent-specific scenarios: networks of agents acting on our behalf, context that shapes model behavior (power of persuasion, product alignment), and the attention dynamics of human-AI collaboration. Thank you. Janelle
